violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room (26 TAC §746.2805(7))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room
violation_type.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver locked children in the bathroom and turned the lights off.

finding_variants.text: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver locked children in the bathroom and turned the lights off.
A child was napping in a restrictive device becuase the child will not sit still. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver released the child.
A child was placed in a bathroom twice as a form of punishment.
As part of discipline, children have been made to sit/stand in timeout in a bathroom.
This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient when a caregiver locked a child in a dark bathroom as a form of "isolation."

This rule was evaluated with regard to an investigation and has been found to be in violation with the Minimum Standard Rules for Licensed Child Care Center based on interview with victim, parent, and caregivers.  Caregiver admitted that he said inappropriate word to a child.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: During the investigation inspection staff admitted to witnessing the child placed in the bathroom and holding the door.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver did not use positive interaction when she placed a child in the bathroom as a way for the child to calm down when they were upset.
Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Because a child refused to nap it was determined that a caregiver placed them in a closed restroom for approximately 5 minutes.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: This rule is being evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be in non-compliance with the minimum standard rules.  There is evident that a caregiver took a two year old child to the closet and remained inside for approximately 1 minute 30 seconds.
Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: During an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver placed a child in the restroom with the door closed.
Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: A caregiver placed a child in a closet as a form of punishment.
Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: A caregiver placed a child alone in a dark restroom for approximately six minutes as a form of prohibited punishment.
Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Caregivers placed children in a closet as punishment and/or redirection.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Based on the evidence obtained, there is sufficient evidence of a child being placed in the restroom with the lights turned off in response to a child crying.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: It was found during investigation that a caregiver inappropriately disciplined a child by placing the child in the bathroom area and closing the door. While the child was in the bathroom the child sustained an injury and needed medical attention.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a student was placed into a restroom with the door closed as a form of punishment.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Video footage from the operation's classroom camera shows a caregiver holding the door of a bathroom closed so that a child could not get out of the room.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Children were placed in bathrooms to manage their challenging behaviors. The practice is not in accordance with childcare regulation standards for positive guidance and discipline.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: Based on information obtained in a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a child in care was placed in a dark closet as a form of discipline.

Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: This standard was evaluated for this investigation.  Based on the information provided, the child was placed in a classroom restroom as a form of punishment and not allowed to exit the restroom.
